parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans expression or organised sweeps, and functioning courts, pending litigation and federal hate-crime cover provide partial recourse. Against that, traveller-facing exposures are documented: passport/visa discrepancy can lead to refusal and a possible fraud-based lifetime bar; public-school (and unverified college) bathroom rules and the 2025 binary-sex law create facility-exclusion risk; the state offers no public-accommodations or state hate-crime protection and has low support for trans inclusion; and immigration-detention abuse and hormone-removal in custody are documented without effective correction. The 3.8/100k figure is an undercount floor and is disregarded.
